changeRecord.title: moment frame pinned at every beam-column joint
changeRecord.target: major-axis bending rotation released at 2 beam end(s) at the columns
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A moment frame resists sway by the bending of beams and columns through rigid joints. With every beam-column joint pinned the beams become simply supported and no longer restrain the columns: on pinned bases the frame is a sway mechanism (no solution, the answer is the diagnosis); on fixed or partially fixed bases the columns act as cantilevers from the base and the drift and base moments grow several times.
changeRecord.precondition: non-vertical frame members (beams) with a rigidly connected end at a node where a vertical frame member (column) ends
